title: Share dB-to-gain, key validation and id generation instead of re-implementing them
description:
- `10f*.powf(x / 20.0)` is written inline twelve times across dsp, engine, score and cli (`dsp/src/color.rs:22,140,167`, `fx.rs:291,389`, `render.rs:124`, `play.rs:52,195`, and others).
- `cli/src/serve.rs:165 safe_key` re-implements `apricity_data::files::valid_key` (`data/src/files.rs:50`) but disagrees with it: it accepts `.` segments.
- `serve.rs:372 uuid_like()` hand-rolls ids although `uuid` is already a dependency of apricity-data.

Done when: one `decibels_to_gain` lives in apricity-dsp and is used everywhere; serve uses `valid_key`; ids come from `uuid`.
